name: Robert clef de 12
notes: The canyon sector: shady, nice on very hot days.
Climbing is often vertical or even slightly overhanging.
routes: Very nice, physical route. One move that is very demanding on core strength for the grade. Crack climbing on jugs and big pockets — you climb through the jackdaws' nests.
Finishing variant of 207. A very fun, airy diagonal ramp.
Ben Hur descends de ton youpala
Ben Hur, Get Out of Your Baby Walker
Climbing on rock that is more solid than it looks in the first part. Slightly steep pillar at the top that requires climbing with rhythm.
Bulges that are hard to negotiate.
Start up 210, then the same finish as Câlin express. Nice route that requires a well-paced, rhythmic climb.
Named after the landlady of the Saffres bar, back when there was one. A great journey with an intense boulder move.
Straight up the steep ground. Very nice route where you need to manage the rests well — a beautiful onsight to do, but not a given. A Saffres staple.
Technical, varied route — one of the crag's classics at the grade.
Very nice, continuous and really pumpy route. Pillar that demands a strong sense of route-reading.
Mixed route with an easier section in the middle. Save some energy for the top moves, which need strength and real determination.
Consistent, fairly complex route that needs technique and good route-reading. A must-do.
Sustained climbing with an intense move on a hard-to-hold sloper mid-route; the rest is really pumpy and very pretty.
Route with an original line. Physical start on edges, a slightly unsettling traverse right and an easier finish in a corner. Slightly loose rock that needs care.
Very bouldery, with one move where you'll have to get angry. Easier exit crack.
Easy route that needs good anticipation of the line. Some ledges break the rhythm.
Stainless Steel from Floor to Ceiling
Steep start on jugs, a section shared with route 218. Mixed route.
Surprising, bouldery route. 3 boulder-style sections broken up by ledges. Not the most interesting at the grade.
Tintin in the Land of Flakes
Slab lovers will be happy here. Profile somewhat like route 221. Bouldery sections broken up by good rests. Smearing and balance to the fore.
Starting variant of 224. More direct crimpy slab.
Fairly demanding crack climbing. A route that needs good jamming and bridging technique. A band of loose rock in the first part — be careful.
Very pleasant route on very beautiful, well-sculpted rock.
Finishing variant of route 225. Exit through a steep section with hidden holds; very enjoyable climbing.
Sustained and continuous. Very nice route with a nasty start and great atmosphere at the top.
Varied route with steep ground, slab and crack. A route for all-round climbers. Exposure in the second part of the route.
